title: Using a Metronome for Consistent Guitar Timing: 80 BPM Start and Down-Strum Practice
summary: This JustinGuitar tutorial demystifies the metronome and demonstrates its value for beginner guitarists. It defines what a metronome is, explains BPM (beats per minute), and contrasts wind-up analog devices with digital options and mobile apps. The video highlights using an app-based metronome (specifically the Justin Guitar Time Trainer Metronome) and sets 80 BPM as a practical starting tempo. Viewers are guided to align a simple down-strum with the beat, optionally tapping a foot to the tempo, and to avoid rushing or anticipating the click. The instructor emphasizes that timing is a core musical skill that improves with steady metronome practice, including its application to various strumming patterns. A portion of the lesson invites learners to experiment with metronome practice beyond the first weeks and to use the Justin Guitar app as a convenient practice tool.
